scope: Make a missing target in a declared LTYPE_CONTROL member slot visible to strict consumers while preserving tolerant read callbacks.

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.57
authority.finding: A complete LTYPE_CONTROL profile requires ordinary counted entries and its two special linetype entries. A zero target in a declared slot is incomplete graph membership; this receipt does not infer a replacement target or alter the source bytes.

implementation.diagnostic: The first zero orderedHandleSlots entry emits DwgIntegrityCheckKind::TableControlNullMember as an Error, anchored to the LTYPE_CONTROL source frame and control handle. expected/observed retain the slot's expected and original H ownership roles.
implementation.compatibility: Parsing and tolerant callbacks are unchanged. The new enum value is appended after existing diagnostic values. Strict completeness observes the Error and continues to refuse the incomplete graph.
implementation.coverage: Generated AC1015 controls exercise one null counted slot and one null phantom slot, each with the corresponding soft-owner or hard-owner H role. Existing controls continue to check valid roles, wrong non-null roles, table traversal, and retry/reset behavior.
implementation.fixtures: No DWG or DXF fixture was added or changed.

validation.result: Build passed with -Werror. Focused generated CTest passed 1/1 in 0.49 seconds. git diff --check passed.

limitations: Only the first null or role-mismatched slot in a control is diagnosed; strict refusal needs one Error.
The diagnostic anchors the control frame but does not carry a separate slot-index field.
It does not identify a replacement target, close the source graph, qualify a producer profile, or establish native linetype meaning.
